pageTitle: Mini Pitch: mini football against bots | Scor3
pageDesc: Pick a character and play a 2–5 minute mini football match against a bot. Win to unlock new characters. Free, in your browser.
title: Mini Pitch
intro: Pick your character and play a quick match against a bot. Win to unlock new characters.

req.cleanSheetWin: Beat a Medium or Hard bot without conceding

guestNote: Unlocked characters are saved in this browser only. Sign in to keep them on your account.

controls.title: How to play
controls.desktop: Move with the arrow keys or WASD. Shoot with Space or X: hold it and you shoot as soon as you touch the ball. Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Turn your phone sideways. Touch and drag on the left to move, hold the SHOOT button bottom right to shoot.
controls.rules: If it's level at full time, golden goal: next goal wins.

rotate: Turn your phone sideways for the best experience
